fact: A written reply of the Prime Minister, relayed on 29 March 2025, says the national statistics council has a working group updating the data-exchange agreement protocols between sectors for faster data sharing, and that the Interior Ministry has recruited 1,600 statistics engineers in communes to improve the quality of data collected at municipal offices.
title: الوزير الأول يكشف عن إجراءات جديدة لتطوير الديوان الوطني للإحصائيات ورفع جودة أدائه
